SELECT SUM(cxConsumeQty) as cxConsumeQty FROM (SELECT IFNULL(sum(cxr.NIGHT_PLAN_QTY), 0) as cxConsumeQty FROM T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr WHERE cxr.schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL
SELECT IFNULL(sum(cxr.DAY_PLAN_QTY), 0) as cxConsumeQty FROM T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT cxr WHERE cxr.schedule_date = DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) t

SELECT steel_ring_code, SUM(night_plan_qty) as lastMidPlanQty FROM t_gsq_schedule_result WHERE schedule_date = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) and INSTR(steel_type, #{steelType}) > 0 and INSTR(steel_ring_code, #{steelRingCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and production_status = #{productionStatus} and instr(concat(',',machine_id,','), concat(',',#{machineId},','))>0
and IS_RELEASE = #{isRelease} GROUP BY steel_ring_code
